product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI provides GPU cloud and dedicated infrastructure plus a unified API for deploying and running open-weight AI models, aimed at developers, researchers, and enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes GPU infrastructure and inference for open models and identifies developers, researchers, and enterprises as audiences.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists per-token model rates and GPU compute/appliance pricing categories.

named_customers.notes: The case studies page names Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology; Qubrid's GPU product page features a testimonial from Dan Japa, Chief Revenue Officer at Lern.Law.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 11–50 employees, which does not resolve to one of the requested bands (11–20 or 21–50). The enum value is a placeholder because the output schema requires one; it is not asserted.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists McLean, Virginia as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists 2024 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The index is dominated by model coverage, pricing, benchmarks, and developer guides. The visible material does not establish at least two engineer-authored posts about how Qubrid itself is built; the technical infrastructure post located is by “Qubrid Team,” not identified engineers.

public_docs.notes: Public docs include multiple articles and sections for getting started, compute, inference, integrations, API reference, troubleshooting, and more.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job posting is titled “Full Stack AI Engineer,” matching the specified AI role criteria.

model_provider.value: Qubrid lists models from providers including Moonshot AI, MiniMax, Meta, NVIDIA, Alibaba/Qwen, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Tencent Hunyuan, OpenAI, and MistralAI.
model_provider.notes: These are providers represented in Qubrid's public model catalog; the platform offers a range of open models rather than identifying one exclusive model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited post says Qubrid operates hardware in SOC 2-compliant data centers. This is the public SOC 2 claim found; it does not establish that Qubrid itself holds a SOC 2 certification.

last_funding.notes: Crunchbase exposes a pre-seed round but its announcement date and amount are obfuscated in the accessible profile. Other funding-directory results conflict, so the complete latest-round details cannot be asserted safely.

raised_18mo.notes: The listed pre-seed round's date is obfuscated, so it cannot be placed relative to the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. The boolean is a schema-required placeholder and is not asserted.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The available Qubrid career postings found were engineering roles (Full Stack AI Engineer and GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer), not SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Qubrid published “GLM-5.3 API Is Now Live on Qubrid AI” on August 24, 2026, inside the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The accessible About page names the Founder & CEO but is not a complete, dated team roster. No qualifying join/departure in the window was verified; the boolean is a schema-required placeholder, not an assertion.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public documentation portal and partner page were readable, but the reviewed material named no CRM or sales/marketing system.
